upsample2_tensor: upsample a PyTorch tensor by 2x using sinc interpolation with a configurable kernel size
downsample2_tensor: downsample a PyTorch tensor by 2x using sinc interpolation with a configurable kernel size
kernel_upsample2_create: create a Hann-windowed sinc kernel for upsampling by 2 with a configurable number of zeros
kernel_downsample2_create: create a Hann-windowed sinc kernel for downsampling by 2 with a configurable number of zeros
sinc_compute: compute the sinc function on a PyTorch tensor, safely handling zero inputs
